newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian mountaineer dies on descent from Everest.
newsitem.headline: Russian mountaineer dies on descent from Everest.

text.p: A Russian mountaineer died on the slopes of Mount Everest after climbing the world's highest peak and two others are missing after a storm, Interfax news agency said on Sunday.
Interfax quoted Russia's Emergencies Ministry as saying Alexander Toroshchin had died on the way down from the world's highest mountain in the Himalayas. It did not say how he died.
Contact with two other members of the expedition, Ivan Plotniov and Nikolai Shevchenko, was lost after storm-force winds followed by mist. Their fate was not known.
